heading: Sample-vs-fire ordering
text:
### Sample-vs-fire ordering [LSER.8.6]

**Sample absorption is a step of the pump, not a rule, and it runs once, after
the agenda has drained.** Within one pump the series are frozen:
every rule that fires reads the same snapshot, the one that held when the pump
began. Nothing an author writes can observe a partially-absorbed series.

The rule that reads: **within a pump the world is frozen except for working
memory.** Series state is pump-driven for the same reason the clock is
([LTIM.2.1.3]) — and one rule for both is the point.
